en.headline: MegaBox opens Christmas Music Hall with corgi Mochi as resident singer
en.dek: The Kowloon Bay mall said its L5 atrium becomes a vintage record room from today until 3 January, with a six-metre music tree and golden Christmas forest on the rooftop garden.
body: MegaBox in Kowloon Bay has opened its Christmas Music Hall display, transforming the L5 atrium into a vintage record room from 23 November until 3 January.

The mall said the space features turntables, an album-cover wall, classic speakers, headphones on a red wall and a vintage microphone on a circular stage. The popular corgi character Mochi appears as the resident singer performing Christmas tunes. A six-metre-high music Christmas tree and a classical clock tower form part of the installation.

On the L18 rooftop Mega Sky garden, the mall has created a golden Christmas forest. In the evenings the lights face a 270-degree view of Kowloon East. Pets are welcome. Visitors who like the mall’s Instagram page and complete a designated task with a same-day spending receipt can collect a mini Mochi Christmas vinyl record that plays music when held near a phone, on selected dates from 28 November.

zh.headline: MegaBox聖誕音樂館開幕 哥基麻粑化身駐場歌手
zh.dek: 九龍灣MegaBox表示，L5中庭由今日起至1月3日化身復古唱片室，設6米高音樂聖誕樹，頂層空中花園則變金色聖誕叢林。
body: 九龍灣MegaBox由今日起至明年1月3日舉行「聖誕音樂館：璀璨聖誕之旅」，L5中庭化身為復古聖誕唱片室。
商場表示，場內有黑膠唱盤、專輯封面牆、經典喇叭、紅牆耳機及單層圓形舞台上的復古麥克風。人氣哥基「Mochi麻粑」化身駐場歌手獻唱聖誕樂章。中庭設高達6米的音樂聖誕樹及古典鐘樓裝置。
頂層L18 Mega Sky空中花園則打造金色聖誕叢林，傍晚燈光映襬270度九龍東夜景，歡迎毛孩與主人打卡。顧客憑即日消費收據讚好商場Instagram專頁並完成指定任務，可於11月28日起指定日子獲贈迷你麻粑聖誕黑膠唱片，貼近手機即可播放音樂。
